annotations.title: Dutch mortgage: how much you can borrow, monthly cost and tax saving

description: For buying a home in the Netherlands in 2026: an indicative maximum mortgage on income, the monthly annuity payment, the first-year mortgage interest deduction worked out with the real Box 1 calculation (eigenwoningforfait, the deduction capped at the second-bracket rate), net monthly cost and whether NHG (national mortgage guarantee) is possible.

claimant_gross_income.description: Gross income of the partner who takes the interest deduction. Default: the household income.

gross_annual_income.description: Household gross annual income in euros (both partners together)

interest_rate_percent.description: Yearly interest rate in %, e.g. 3.9. Default 4. Use a current quote when you have one.

loan_amount.description: Mortgage amount. Default: the price (Dutch mortgages go up to 100% of the value).

other_monthly_debt.description: Other monthly debt payments (student loan, car loan). Default 0.

price.description: Purchase price of the home in euros
